_meta.purpose: Pre-loaded agri-solutions capability map (L1 > L2) for Screen 2 - Business Capabilities (TOGAF Phase B).
_meta.seed_scores: ALL seed scores are 'assumed' illustrative values for the demo. The questionnaire replaces them. q = [process, technology & AI enablement, data, integration] each 1-5; importance 1-5.
_meta.focus_area_link: focus = CIL digital focus area id from vision.json (F1-F5) - used by the gap rules for urgency.
_meta.structure: L0 (value-chain group) > L1 > L2 > L3 (sub-capability / process). Owners are role-based placeholders (assumed). ref links each node to seed/reference_model.json. depends_on lists upstream L2s whose outputs the capability consumes (entanglement). L3 is what current-state discovery surveys; L2 scores are inferred from L3 responses once analysed.

questions.label: Process standardisation
questions.text: How standardised and measured is this capability's process across plants, regions and entities?

questions.label: Technology & AI enablement
questions.text: What level of technology and AI supports this capability today?

options.label: Manual / siloed tools
options.hint: Paper, Excel, email or standalone tools

options.label: Digitised
options.hint: Work recorded in a system of record; hand-offs still manual

options.label: Integrated automation
options.hint: Workflow, RPA or straight-through processing across systems

options.label: AI-enabled
options.hint: ML or GenAI assists decisions; people act on recommendations

options.label: Agentic AI
options.hint: AI agents plan and execute tasks within guardrails, with human oversight

questions.label: Data availability & trust
questions.text: Is the data this capability needs available, owned and trusted?

questions.label: Integration & hand-offs
questions.text: How are hand-offs with other capabilities and systems handled?

questions.label: Importance to 2030 strategy
questions.text: How important is this capability to CIL's 2030 strategy?
